title: Veteran Vadrel's raid
summary: Defend two northern camps with Veterans Vadrel and Cullin.
overview: Show Vadrel the medal from Necin's mission, then return the plans when ready. Follow the veterans and clear both camps after the assault resets their populations.
Reinforcement waves begin after 30 to 60 seconds and then arrive every minute. Protect both veterans while watching for a grimling commander at either camp.

phases.label: Take both camps
phases.description: Clear both camp areas to start the defense.

phases.label: Defeat the commander
phases.description: Follow the veterans' warning to the correct camp. Kill the commander and return its proof to Vadrel. Either veteran's death fails the event.

sections.title: Entry requirements
paragraphs: Present the prior medal and then return Vadrel's plans.

notes: Approved row E137. Quest source reviewed; live encounter behavior and loaded database spell/loot data have not been verified.
Unlike Necin's controller, this controller does not stop the waves immediately on commander spawn; no pause is promised.
